Secure required approvals and verify readiness before introducing changes into test or production environments. Identify, prioritize, and implement opportunities to standardize or automate configuration within the approved Orion framework. Lead functional, integration, end-to-end, security, user acceptance, regression, and cutover testing. Confirm the system produces accurate calculations, accounting entries, approvals, and reports. Own defect resolution: establish priority and accountability, drive root-cause correction, retest the solution, and secure business validation before closure. Direct data owners and migration resources through complete validation of converted data, resolving reconciliation gaps before approval. Confirm users can perform critical transactions before go-live. Lead hands-on support, coaching, triage, and problem resolution during go-live and stabilization, ensuring every critical issue has an owner, resolution plan, due date, and verified outcome. Monitor system usage, support trends, process compliance, and business results. Identify the root cause of adoption gaps, manual workarounds, and underused functionality; implement corrective actions and confirm sustained adoption. Hold OpCos and implementation teams accountable for using the technology to improve billing, cash flow, project margins, service productivity, purchasing controls, payroll accuracy, reporting, and close performance. Own stabilization through completion and transition the OpCo to a sustainable support model with clear accountability, documentation, performance measures, and no unresolved critical issues. Familiarity with internal controls, segregation of duties, audit readiness, and SOX-aligned processes. Users are trained and able to perform their responsibilities effectively. Revenue, billing, cash, payroll, purchasing, WIP, and financial close continue without material interruption, and variances are resolved quickly when they occur. OpCos use the technology to improve operational visibility, financial controls, project performance, and decision-making. Implementations become faster, more consistent, and less dependent on external consultants through repeatable execution, decisive issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

review_candidates.title: Werkvoorbereider / Engineer – Ridderkerk
review_candidates.description: Functieomschrijving Als Werkvoorbereider / Engineer start je met het ondersteunen van projecten: je verwerkt gegevens, bereidt werkzaamheden voor en leert hoe het netwerk van KPN in elkaar zit. Bij Allinq ontwikkel jij je stap voor stap jouw technische skills en neem je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? In deze rolben jij dé schakel die zorgt voor slimme oplossingen en topkwaliteit. Jij gaat verder dan alleen het leveren van goed werk. Jij verrast onze klanten door nét dat stapje extra te zetten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp en de voorbereiding van uitbreidingen, upgrades en migraties binnen het netwerk van onze klant. Dit zijn de belangrijkste taken voor een deze combi rol als werkvoorbereider/engineer : Klantaanvragen verwerken, informatie verzamelen uit klantsystemen en zorgen dat alle projectinformatie compleet en actueel is. Ontwerpen van fysieke netwerkdelen en voorbereiden van alle benodigde gegevens voor een succesvolle uitvoering. Uitvoeren site-surveys Klantafspraken maken en de voortgang, planning en kwaliteit van projecten bewaken. Coördineren van alle voorbereidende werkzaamheden, inclusief vergunningen, werkpakketten, materiaalvoorziening en uitvoeringsdocumentatie. Afstemmen en onderhandelen met onderaannemers, leveranciers en andere betrokken partijen. Opstellen van duidelijke uitvoeringsinstructies en zorgen dat monteurs en onderaannemers optimaal voorbereid aan het werk kunnen. Bewaken van de voortgang, signaleren van knelpunten en proactief bijsturen waar nodig. Schakelen tussen klant, engineering, uitvoering en planning om projecten efficiënt en succesvol te realiseren. Meedenken over verbeteringen, alternatieve oplossingen en de beste aanpak bij technische uitdagingen. Zorgen dat alles gestructureerd, foutloos en op het juiste moment gereedstaat voor uitvoering. Kortom: jij bent dé cruciale schakel achter een betrouwbaar netwerk! Waarom Allinq? Bij Allinq krijg je volop ruimte om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je volgt opleidingen, krijgt persoonlijke coaching en werkt mee aan projecten die écht impact hebben. Je merkt direct hoe jouw inzet bijdraagt aan het succes van het team en de projecten. Afwisseling en uitdaging staan centraal: geen dag is hetzelfde en je groeit zowel op administratief als technisch vlak. Binnen een betrokken, energiek team leer je samenwerken, communiceren en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, terwijl je je talenten maximaal inzet. Je standplaats is Ridderkerk, waar je dagelijks samenwerkt met collega’s aan impactvolle projecten. Daarnaast ben je regelmatig aanwezig op ons kantoor in Harderwijk voor afstemming, ontwikkeling en samenwerking binnen Allinq. Wie zijn wij? Bij Allinq draait alles om verbinding. Al meer dan 60 jaar ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden we de netwerken die Nederland online houden. Van glasvezel en coax tot draadloze verbindingen, boven én onder de grond. Met ruim 800 vakmensen en betrouwbare partners werken we voor opdrachtgevers als KPN, VodafoneZiggo en Glaspoort. We staan bekend om onze slimme, duurzame aanpak en hechte samenwerking in de keten. Allinq is onderdeel van de Allinq Group met ruim 2.000 collega’s in Nederland, Duitsland en Tsjechië. Samen bouwen we elke dag aan een verbonden en toekomstbestendig netwerk. Wat breng je mee? Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau Affiniteit met techniek en administratie Leergierigheid, nauwkeurigheid en communicatieve vaardigheden Ambitie om te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen Teamspeler die graag samenwerkt in een enthousiast en betrokken team Kennis van KPN netwerkstructuren en ervaring met klantsystemen zoals GEOS, ZSmart is een pre Zorgvuldigheid is voor ons belangrijk. Een (beperkte) screening zal daarom onderdeel zijn van de selectieprocedure. Mocht je hierover meer willen weten, neem dan contact op met de recruiter die deze vacature in beheer heeft. Wat bieden wij? Een werkgever waar je op kunt bouwen! Onze medewerkers bepalen het succes van Allinq. Samen moeten we de klus klaren, onze manier van werken is daarom heel bepalend. We hebben een bijzondere cultuur waarin we je kansen bieden om te blijven groeien. Uitdaging om continue in beweging te blijven. Fijne collega's die je graag verder helpen. En een werkklimaat waarin we je stimuleren om met verbeterideeën te komen! Verder Krijg Je Een salaris tussen de € 3.391 en € 3.889, gebaseerd op 38 uur, volgens de CAO Kleinmetaal en Techniek . 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen, bij een fulltime dienstverband. 8% vakantiegeld. Een reiskostvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer. Een telefoon en laptop van de zaak. De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, met een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,45 per dag. Een goede pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds PMT. Allinq kan onder voorwaarden kinderen van medewerkers voordragen voor een bijdrage in de studiekosten via de onafhankelijke stichting Educatie4All. Zie jij jezelf werken als Engineer bij Allinq en wil jij jouw technische skills ontwikkelen? Solliciteer dan direct en draag bij aan het netwerk van KPN.

Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix; iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America; We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour; iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America; Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone. Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia! If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: The Vice President, Unified Partnerships is a senior sales leader responsible for driving revenue growth through the development and management of strategic agency and public sector partnerships. This role builds and maintains long-term relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across advertising agencies, government entities, nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, and other public-sector stakeholders. The VP serves as a trusted advisor to agency partners by delivering innovative marketing solutions, identifying new business opportunities, and leveraging a deep understanding of the public sector. This position is responsible for generating new revenue, expanding existing partnerships, developing government contracting opportunities, and leading responses to grants, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and procurement initiatives. What You'll Do: Strategic Partnership Development Build, maintain, and expand strategic relationships with executive-level decision-makers and influencers within advertising agencies, public sector organizations, and community partners. Develop new partnership opportunities through networking, market research, industry events, referrals, and strategic outreach. Conduct agency and partner capability presentations showcasing the company's comprehensive marketing and media solutions. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align partnership strategies with organizational growth objectives. Revenue Growth & Sales Leadership Achieve and exceed assigned revenue goals through account growth, new business acquisition, and cross-platform sales initiatives. Create demand for products and services by demonstrating the value and effectiveness of integrated marketing solutions. Identify, qualify, and pursue new prospects while maintaining a robust sales pipeline. Increase revenue per account through strategic planning, client retention, and expansion of services. Utilize data, analytics, and market intelligence to identify emerging opportunities and drive business outcomes. Public Sector & Government Relations Develop and manage relationships with government agencies, municipalities, state agencies, educational institutions, and public-sector organizations. Identify and pursue opportunities within government contracting and public procurement channels. Understand governmental purchasing processes, contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and procurement regulations. Establish strategic partnerships that support public awareness campaigns, community initiatives, and government outreach objectives. Grant & RFP Development Lead and support the development of grant applications, RFP responses, RFQs, and other competitive procurement submissions. Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to create compelling proposals that align with client objectives and funding requirements. Research funding opportunities and government initiatives that align with organizational capabilities. Ensure proposal content, pricing, and compliance requirements are accurate, competitive, and submitted on schedule. Track proposal outcomes and develop strategies to improve future win rates. Media & Marketing Expertise Maintain a comprehensive understanding of all media platforms and marketing channels, including broadcast, digital, social, podcasting, streaming, experiential, and emerging media. Develop integrated marketing solutions that effectively address client challenges and business objectives. Stay informed on industry trends, market conditions, competitive activity, and evolving client needs. Serve as a subject matter expert on media strategy and partnership development. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with sales, marketing, legal, operations, and leadership teams to execute partnership strategies and client initiatives. Provide mentorship and support to team members involved in partnership development and public-sector sales efforts. Represent the organization at industry conferences, trade associations, public meetings, and community events. What You'll Need: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Public Administration, or related field; advanced degree preferred. 5+ years of progressive experience in media sales, agency partnerships, business development, government relations, or related fields. Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding revenue targets within complex sales environments. Experience developing and managing strategic partnerships with agencies, corporations, and public-sector organizations. Knowledge of government contracting processes, procurement requirements, and public-sector sales. Experience writing, leading, or contributing to grant applications, RFPs, RFQs, and proposal development. Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills. Proven ability to engage C-level executives, agency leadership, elected officials, and public-sector stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Existing relationships within advertising agencies, government entities, nonprofit organizations, or educational institutions. Experience selling integrated media, marketing, advertising, sponsorships, or communications solutions. Understanding of federal, state, and local government contracting opportunities. Grant writing certification or demonstrated success securing grant-funded partnerships. CRM proficiency and strong analytical skills. What You'll Bring: Achievement of annual revenue and profitability targets. Growth in agency, public-sector, and strategic partnership accounts. Expansion of government contracting and procurement opportunities. Successful submission and win rates of grants, RFPs, and competitive proposals. Client retention, satisfaction, and long-term partnership growth. Development of new business opportunities and strategic market expansion initiatives. Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members Compensation: Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions. $136,000 - $170,000 Location: Minneapolis, MN: 1600 Utica Avenue South, Suite 500, 55416 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Salaried Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!
